statement.source_mapping: Research/Submission.lean formalizes the full active theorem:cholesky_solve in /spec/source.txt (paper.tex lines 550-610). Traces encode the source recurrences and sequential rounded dot products, with no artificial arithmetic for empty sums. No global backward-error bounds are assumptions. Definitions have actual bodies and only the final theorem proof has temporary sorry scaffolding. Supplied source.txt, plan.json, paper.tex, references.bib, source.pdf were copied unchanged to Research.
